## Legal Entity (LE)

An Account is who you sell to; a Legal Entity is who signs — registered name, entity form, jurisdiction, registration number, masked tax ID, and the authorized signatory.

### Non-goals

Contract.parties is NOT wired here — pointing the shared Contract block at its party entities is additive future work on that block, kept out so this ships without touching shared code. No KYC/verification workflow.
